dialogues.jp:
帰り道、暇を持て余していた俺は、何の気なし
に神社へと足を向けることにした。
dialogues.en:
On the way home, with time on my hands, my feet started
walking by themselves, to the shrine.
dialogues.text:
On the way home, with time on my hands, my feet started
walking by themselves, to the shrine.

dialogues.jp:
信心深い……というわけではまったくなく、本
当に単なる道草だった。
dialogues.en:
My devotion knows no bounds... or not, the truth was, I just
had nothing else to do.
dialogues.text:
My devotion knows no bounds... or not, the truth was, I just
had nothing else to do.

dialogues.jp:
ただし、形だけでもお参りした俺に、神様が望
外の幸運を授けてくれるというのならば、それ
は願ってもないことだが。
dialogues.en:
Besides, just maybe, if I pray for good luck here, some
might come my way.
dialogues.text:
Besides, just maybe, if I pray for good luck here, some
might come my way.

dialogues.jp:
などと虫のいいことを考えながら歩き出すと目
の前によく知っている後ろ姿があった。
dialogues.en:
Thinking simple-mindedly as I walked, my eyes caught a
glimpse of a familiar face.
dialogues.text:
Thinking simple-mindedly as I walked, my eyes caught a
glimpse of a familiar face.

dialogues.jp: （ななこじゃないか）
dialogues.en: "(That's Nanako.)"
dialogues.text: "(That's Nanako.)"

dialogues.jp:
ななこは、歩きながらメモ帳に何かを書き込ん
でいる。
dialogues.en:
Nanako was walking and jotting something down on her memo
pad at the same time.
dialogues.text:
Nanako was walking and jotting something down on her memo
pad at the same time.

dialogues.jp: 構内でも時々見かける彼女のスタイルだ。
dialogues.en:
That's the usual style I've seen her doing all the time, in
school.
dialogues.text:
That's the usual style I've seen her doing all the time, in
school.

dialogues.jp:
まったく、危なっかしい。前を見てないぞ、あ
れ。やはりいつか注意してやらないと……。
dialogues.en:
But that's really dangerous, geez. She's not looking in
front of her at all. If she isn't careful...
dialogues.text:
But that's really dangerous, geez. She's not looking in
front of her at all. If she isn't careful...

dialogues.jp: 俺は小走りにななこに近づいた。
dialogues.en: I moved in closer to the unwitting Nanako.
dialogues.text: I moved in closer to the unwitting Nanako.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「これが、あーなって、そして、こーなるから、
　あぁでも、そーするとこの部分の引きが……」
dialogues.en:
"Now, with this.... and this... oh, but that part doesn't
look right..."
dialogues.text:
"Now, with this.... and this... oh, but that part doesn't
look right..."

dialogues.jp:
ななこは眉間を寄せた難しそうな顔で完全にあっ
ちの世界に行っているらしい。
dialogues.en:
Her brow knitted furiously. She was in a different world
altogether.
dialogues.text:
Her brow knitted furiously. She was in a different world
altogether.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　でもそうすると、｛ゆいか／結花｝の伏線に、意
　味がなくなるから……ってことは、アレをも
　う一度持ってきて……」
dialogues.en:
"Hrm? But if it's that way, Yuika wouldn't have any reason,
and there isn't any foreshadowing... I better do this
again..."
dialogues.text:
"Hrm? But if it's that way, Yuika wouldn't have any reason,
and there isn't any foreshadowing... I better do this
again..."

dialogues.jp: 俺はななこが事故る前に声をかけることにした。
dialogues.en: I called out before she bumped right into me.
dialogues.text: I called out before she bumped right into me.

dialogues.jp: 「前見て歩かないと白いヤギが出てくっぞ」
dialogues.en:
"If you don't look where you're going, a white goat is going
to appear."
dialogues.text:
"If you don't look where you're going, a white goat is going
to appear."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「ヤ、ヤギ！　うひゃぉう！　や、やめて！
　お願いだから原稿にだけは、手をつけない
　でくださいィィ！」
dialogues.en:
"G, g, goat! Wahhhh! S, stop! Pleaseee don't touch my
manuscriiiiipt!!!"
dialogues.text:
"G, g, goat! Wahhhh! S, stop! Pleaseee don't touch my
manuscriiiiipt!!!"

dialogues.jp: ……どうやら、心に深い傷を負っていたようだ。
dialogues.en: ...Looks like the wound remains fresh.
dialogues.text: ...Looks like the wound remains fresh.

dialogues.jp: ちょっぴり悪いことをしたな……。
dialogues.en: I overdid it just a tad...
dialogues.text: I overdid it just a tad...

dialogues.jp:
「ウソウソ、ヤギなんていねぇよ。そう簡単に
　いてたまるかっての」
dialogues.en:
"Just kidding, kidding, there's no goat. One won't just
appear so easily."
dialogues.text:
"Just kidding, kidding, there's no goat. One won't just
appear so easily."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「ひゃううう……って、あ、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Wahhh.... ah, Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Wahhh.... ah, Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.jp:
ななこが我に返ったように、メモ帳から顔を上
げる。
dialogues.en:
Nanako lifted her head from her memo pad, finally noticing
me.
dialogues.text:
Nanako lifted her head from her memo pad, finally noticing
me.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「ひ、ヒドイですよぉ〜〜〜。あの悪夢が再び
　襲ってきたのかと思ったじゃないですかぁ」
dialogues.en:
"T, that was so mean~~~! I thought that demon was going to
attack again!"
dialogues.text:
"T, that was so mean~~~! I thought that demon was going to
attack again!"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「悪ィ悪ィ、まさかそこまでトラウマになって
　いるとは。──それにしても、やるなあ。歩
　きながら試験勉強か？」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry, sorry, I didn't know you were still so traumatized.
...By the way, you're pretty good. Walking and studying in
tandem?"
dialogues.text:
"Sorry, sorry, I didn't know you were still so traumatized.
...By the way, you're pretty good. Walking and studying in
tandem?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「べ、勉強！？　いえいえ、違うんです」
dialogues.en: "S, studying? No, no, not at all."
dialogues.text: "S, studying? No, no, not at all."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、塾の宿題？」
dialogues.en: "Tuition homework, then?"
dialogues.text: "Tuition homework, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「ま、まさか！　あたしが塾だなんて！」
dialogues.en: "N, no way! I don't have that luxury!"
dialogues.text: "N, no way! I don't have that luxury!"

dialogues.jp: ななこが、ぷるぷると首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: Nanako furiously shook her head back and forth.
dialogues.text: Nanako furiously shook her head back and forth.

dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、暇人ご用達のクロスワードパズルと
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Doing something like a crossword puzzle, then?"
dialogues.text: "Doing something like a crossword puzzle, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「……パズルには近いかもしれませんね」
dialogues.en: "...Calling it a puzzle wouldn't be too far off."
dialogues.text: "...Calling it a puzzle wouldn't be too far off."

dialogues.jp: ななこはちょっと考えたあと、そう答えた。
dialogues.en: She answered after a little thought.
dialogues.text: She answered after a little thought.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、テスト前に熱心にパズルとは余裕じゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en:
"But you must be really confident, to be tackling puzzles
with such zest, with the exams just around the corner..."
dialogues.text:
"But you must be really confident, to be tackling puzzles
with such zest, with the exams just around the corner..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「全然、余裕なんてないですよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm not confident at all."
dialogues.text: "I'm not confident at all."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「むしろ、逃げ出したいくらいで……」
dialogues.en:
"It'd be more accurate to say that I'm running away from
it..."
dialogues.text:
"It'd be more accurate to say that I'm running away from
it..."

dialogues.jp: ななこが、ぽつりと呟く。
dialogues.en: Nanako lowered her head, with a sigh.
dialogues.text: Nanako lowered her head, with a sigh.

dialogues.jp: が、｛せき／堰｝を切ったように、
dialogues.en: ...Then, her head suddenly sprang up again,
dialogues.text: ...Then, her head suddenly sprang up again,

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「ああ！　逃げられるモノなら、逃げたいッ！
　どこかずっと遠くへ！　あああ、もう、追い
　かけてこーなーいーでー！」
dialogues.en:
"Yes! I want to run away! Somewhere far away from this! Ahh,
don't catch up with me already!"
dialogues.text:
"Yes! I want to run away! Somewhere far away from this! Ahh,
don't catch up with me already!"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「寝ーかーせーてー！　ごはんを食ーべーさー
　せーてー！　マンガを読ーまーさーせーてー」
dialogues.en: "I want to sleep! Eat! Read my manga~~"
dialogues.text: "I want to sleep! Eat! Read my manga~~"

dialogues.jp:
ななこが頭を抱えて、悲劇の舞台役者みたいに
大げさなリアクションをする。
dialogues.en:
Her head fell to her hands, potraying a tragic heroine from
a play.
dialogues.text:
Her head fell to her hands, potraying a tragic heroine from
a play.

dialogues.jp: 「な、ななこ……サン？」
dialogues.en: "Na, Nanako...-san?"
dialogues.text: "Na, Nanako...-san?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp:
カッと目を見開き、わなわなと震える両手を見
つめる。
dialogues.en:
She closed her eyes for awhile, then reopened them, staring
at her palms.
dialogues.text:
She closed her eyes for awhile, then reopened them, staring
at her palms.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい……。ちょっとせっぱ詰まって
　たものだから……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry... I'm under quite a bit of pressure right
now..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry... I'm under quite a bit of pressure right
now..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「たくさんの人が待ってるんだもの。逃げたり
　なんて、できないですよ」
dialogues.en:
"A lot of people are waiting for it. So I can't just run
away..."
dialogues.text:
"A lot of people are waiting for it. So I can't just run
away..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「……なんだかよくわからないけど」
dialogues.en: "...I don't understand at all."
dialogues.text: "...I don't understand at all."

dialogues.jp: ななこは、たはは……と苦笑する。
dialogues.en: Nanako simply laughed a little.
dialogues.text: Nanako simply laughed a little.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉くんはこれからお家で勉強ですか？」
dialogues.en: "...Are you heading home to study, Asakura-kun?"
dialogues.text: "...Are you heading home to study, Asakura-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「いや。神社でちょっと、お参りでも」
dialogues.en: "Nope. I thought I'd go to the shrine to pray a little."
dialogues.text: "Nope. I thought I'd go to the shrine to pray a little."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.en: "The shrine...?"
dialogues.text: "The shrine...?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「苦しい時の神頼みってやつだ」
dialogues.en: "In times of need, it never hurts to pray for salvation."
dialogues.text: "In times of need, it never hurts to pray for salvation."

dialogues.jp: 意味もなく胸を張って答える。
dialogues.en:
Not really sure of what I was saying either, I answered with
assurance.
dialogues.text:
Not really sure of what I was saying either, I answered with
assurance.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.en: "......Shrine."
dialogues.text: "......Shrine."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「んっ、どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Hm, what?"
dialogues.text: "Hm, what?"

dialogues.jp: 不意にななこが押し黙ってしまった。
dialogues.en: Nanako suddenly became silent as a mouse.
dialogues.text: Nanako suddenly became silent as a mouse.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「お〜い。もしも〜し」
dialogues.en: "Heeey? Anyone there?"
dialogues.text: "Heeey? Anyone there?"

dialogues.jp:
ななこの目の前で手をひらひらと振るが、反応
がない。
dialogues.en:
I waved my hand in front of her face, but got no response
whatsoever.
dialogues.text:
I waved my hand in front of her face, but got no response
whatsoever.

dialogues.jp: 「いったい、どうし……」
dialogues.en: "What is she doi..."
dialogues.text: "What is she doi..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「……よし、わかったぁっ！」
dialogues.en: "...Yes, I got it!"
dialogues.text: "...Yes, I got it!"

dialogues.jp:
まるで、サスペンス映画に出てくるダメ警部の
ように、ズビシィっと、手を掲げるななこ。
dialogues.en:
She hit her palm with her fist, like a police inspector from
some suspense film.
dialogues.text:
She hit her palm with her fist, like a police inspector from
some suspense film.

dialogues.jp: いきなりの大声に俺の心臓が跳ね上がる。
dialogues.en: Her sudden exclamation made me jump back in surprise.
dialogues.text: Her sudden exclamation made me jump back in surprise.

dialogues.jp: 「な、なんだよ、いきなり……」
dialogues.en: "W, what was that, so suddenly..."
dialogues.text: "W, what was that, so suddenly..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉くんが今、素晴らしいヒントをくれたん
　です」
dialogues.en: "You gave me a fantastic hint!"
dialogues.text: "You gave me a fantastic hint!"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「ヒ、ヒント……？」
dialogues.en: "H, hint...?"
dialogues.text: "H, hint...?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「はい。お蔭で思いつきました」
dialogues.en: "Yep. What you said got me thinking."
dialogues.text: "Yep. What you said got me thinking."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「思いついたって、何を……？」
dialogues.en: "Thinking, about...?"
dialogues.text: "Thinking, about...?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「はい、えぇとですね……って、げふげふん。
　その、オホン……内緒です」
dialogues.en: "Yes, about... err, ahem. That's... a secret."
dialogues.text: "Yes, about... err, ahem. That's... a secret."

dialogues.jp: 肝心なところをはぐらかされてしまった。
dialogues.en: Of course, she couldn't reveal the most important part.
dialogues.text: Of course, she couldn't reveal the most important part.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、それでななこの中の何かが解決ついたの
ならいいんだけど。
dialogues.en:
Well, as long as it's settled something inside her, it's
fine.
dialogues.text:
Well, as long as it's settled something inside her, it's
fine.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんって座禅をしたことありますか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, have you tried meditation before?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, have you tried meditation before?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ、いきなり」
dialogues.en: "You're full of abruptness today, aren't you?"
dialogues.text: "You're full of abruptness today, aren't you?"

dialogues.jp: 話が三段跳びしていて、ついていけないぞ。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't keep up with the hop, skip and jump in her train
of thought.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't keep up with the hop, skip and jump in her train
of thought.

dialogues.jp:
「座禅て、あれか。｛けっかふざ／結跏跌坐｝をしながら｛きょうさく／警策｝っ
　て棒で坊さんに後ろからどつかれるやつだろ」
dialogues.en:
"Meditation, huh. You mean those monks sitting in the lotus
position, carrying a wooden pole on their shoulders?"
dialogues.text:
"Meditation, huh. You mean those monks sitting in the lotus
position, carrying a wooden pole on their shoulders?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「……それだけ言える人はなかなかいませんよ」
dialogues.en: "...I didn't know that really happened."
dialogues.text: "...I didn't know that really happened."

dialogues.jp:
ほへー妙なため息をついてから、ななこは感心
したようにそう言う。
dialogues.en: Nanako had a surprised look on her face.
dialogues.text: Nanako had a surprised look on her face.

dialogues.jp:
「杉並のバカが以前、座禅の悟りが宇宙パワー
　とどうたらとか講釈を垂れていたんでな。お
　蔭でいらん知識が増えてしまったが」
dialogues.en:
"I know way too much about it, from when it was Suginami's
obssession, thinking it was some space power."
dialogues.text:
"I know way too much about it, from when it was Suginami's
obssession, thinking it was some space power."

dialogues.jp:
「だけど俺のは知識だけで、実際に座禅を組ん
　だことはないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not really sure how it's done in the real world,
though."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not really sure how it's done in the real world,
though."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「だいたい、俺が座禅を組むようなタイプに見
　えるか？」
dialogues.en:
"Besides, do I look like the type who would participate in
meditation?"
dialogues.text:
"Besides, do I look like the type who would participate in
meditation?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「……仰角斜め４５度からなら、何とか見えな
　いことも」
dialogues.en:
"...No matter what angle, I don't think I can see you as
one."
dialogues.text:
"...No matter what angle, I don't think I can see you as
one."

dialogues.jp:
ななこが両手でファインダーを作りながら、下
から俺を覗く。
dialogues.en:
Nanako was making a square with her thumbs and index
fingers, peering at me through it.
dialogues.text:
Nanako was making a square with her thumbs and index
fingers, peering at me through it.

dialogues.jp: ったく。どこの角度だ、そりゃ。
dialogues.en: Psh, what kind of angle is that.
dialogues.text: Psh, what kind of angle is that.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「お願いです、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "I have a request to ask of you, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "I have a request to ask of you, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: ななこが俺を拝むように両の｛てのひら／掌｝を合わせる。
dialogues.en: Her hands turned into one of pleading.
dialogues.text: Her hands turned into one of pleading.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「座禅をやってください」
dialogues.en: "Please meditate."
dialogues.text: "Please meditate."

dialogues.jp:
なぜに、俺が座禅を……という疑問が頭をよぎ
る。
dialogues.en: Why me, and meditation... that question ran around my head.
dialogues.text: Why me, and meditation... that question ran around my head.

dialogues.jp:
だいたい、座禅みたいな精神修養は、自分でやっ
てこそ意味があるんじゃないのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
After all, if your mind and body isn't completely focused
into it, there's no reason to...
dialogues.text:
After all, if your mind and body isn't completely focused
into it, there's no reason to...

dialogues.jp:
「……それは、なんでもやる約束のうちに含ま
　れるってことか？」
dialogues.en:
"...I know I promised to do whatever I can, but isn't that a
bit... much?"
dialogues.text:
"...I know I promised to do whatever I can, but isn't that a
bit... much?"

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「そう言えば、そんな約束をしてましたね。な
　ら、その約束でお願いしたいのですが……」
dialogues.en:
"Now that you said it, you did promise... in that case,
please do it in return..."
dialogues.text:
"Now that you said it, you did promise... in that case,
please do it in return..."

dialogues.jp:
ななこが、パンと両手を合わせて、平身低頭で
懇願する。
dialogues.en: Nanako clasped her hands together, and dropped to her knees.
dialogues.text: Nanako clasped her hands together, and dropped to her knees.

dialogues.jp: ここまでされて、まさか断る訳には……。
dialogues.en: If she's that desperate, I can't refuse...
dialogues.text: If she's that desperate, I can't refuse...

dialogues.jp: 「……でも、座禅をやれったって場所が……」
dialogues.en: "...But there's no place to meditate effectively..."
dialogues.text: "...But there's no place to meditate effectively..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「ありますよ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, there is."
dialogues.text: "Yes, there is."

dialogues.jp: ななこがニッコリと笑う。
dialogues.en: Nanako gave me a knowing smile.
dialogues.text: Nanako gave me a knowing smile.

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、ここは神社じゃないですか！」
dialogues.en: "This place IS a shrine, after all!"
dialogues.text: "This place IS a shrine, after all!"

dialogues.jp: ぐぐっと握った拳を強く突き出す。
dialogues.en: She raised her fist in victory.
dialogues.text: She raised her fist in victory.

dialogues.jp: ……ななこさん、ここは、その。
dialogues.en: ...Nanako-san, this is, kind of...
dialogues.text: ...Nanako-san, this is, kind of...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「座禅……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Meditation... you say?"
dialogues.text: "Meditation... you say?"

dialogues.jp: 予想通り、さすがの環も困惑したようだった。
dialogues.en: Just as I had foresaw, even Tamaki was perplexed.
dialogues.text: Just as I had foresaw, even Tamaki was perplexed.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「残念ですが、当家は｛ゼンシュウ／禅宗｝ではありませんので」
dialogues.en:
"Unfortunately, we do not have any practitioners of the Zen
sect here..."
dialogues.text:
"Unfortunately, we do not have any practitioners of the Zen
sect here..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "I, I see..."
dialogues.text: "I, I see..."

dialogues.jp:
見た目にもわかるほど、ななこが、がっくりと
落ちこむ。
dialogues.en: Nanako fell to her knees again, this time in defeat.
dialogues.text: Nanako fell to her knees again, this time in defeat.

dialogues.jp: 思わず、メガネが外れて落ちそうだ。
dialogues.en: Her glasses fell off her face, and onto the floor.
dialogues.text: Her glasses fell off her face, and onto the floor.

dialogues.jp: まあ、仕方ないだろう。
dialogues.en: Well, nothing we can do.
dialogues.text: Well, nothing we can do.

dialogues.jp: 神社といえば神道であり、禅宗は仏教だからだ。
dialogues.en: This is a Shinto shrine after all, Zen is from Buddhism.
dialogues.text: This is a Shinto shrine after all, Zen is from Buddhism.

dialogues.jp:
ぱっと考えても、出てくるのは神主ではなく和
尚だ。
dialogues.en:
...Although now that I think about it, I haven't seen either
type of priest here recently.
dialogues.text:
...Although now that I think about it, I haven't seen either
type of priest here recently.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ご期待に添えず、申し訳ありませんが……」
dialogues.en: "My apologies for not meeting your expectations..."
dialogues.text: "My apologies for not meeting your expectations..."

dialogues.speaker: Nanako
dialogues.jp:
「はうあうあ〜。ってことは、また考え直しっ
　てことか〜〜〜」
dialogues.en: "Hauwahwah... I have to think of another way now~~~"
dialogues.text: "Hauwahwah... I have to think of another way now~~~"

dialogues.jp: ななこが、ずるずると畳の上にだらりとへばる。
dialogues.en: Nanako fell backwards onto the tatami mats, exhausted.
dialogues.text: Nanako fell backwards onto the tatami mats, exhausted.

dialogues.jp:
「よくはわからんが、まあ神社でできるのは、
　お｛はら／祓｝いとおみくじくらいってことだな」
dialogues.en:
"I don't understand much, but Shinto shrines seem to
specialize in exorcism anyway."
dialogues.text:
"I don't understand much, but Shinto shrines seem to
specialize in exorcism anyway."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、湯飲みに入ったお茶を、ずずずと飲んだ。
dialogues.en: I sipped away at the tea from my teacup.
dialogues.text: I sipped away at the tea from my teacup.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様。神社では他にも色々ございますよ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama. Shinto shrines do a lot more than that."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama. Shinto shrines do a lot more than that."

dialogues.jp: 環は、そうにっこりと笑った。
dialogues.en: Tamaki smiled, gently correcting me.
dialogues.text: Tamaki smiled, gently correcting me.

dialogues.jp: ◆座禅のお願い◆
dialogues.en: ◆Request To Meditate?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Request To Meditate?◆

dialogues.jp:
帰り道、何気なく神社に立ち寄る事にした俺は
思索にふけりながら歩くななこに出会った。
dialogues.en:
On the way home, stopping by the shrine for a bit, I met
Nanako, absorbed in the thought of meditation.
dialogues.text:
On the way home, stopping by the shrine for a bit, I met
Nanako, absorbed in the thought of meditation.

dialogues.jp:
話していると、なにやら｛ひらめ／閃｝いたらしく、俺に神
社で座禅を組んで欲しいと言うななこ。
dialogues.en:
With a sudden flash of inspiration, she begged me to go to
the shrine to meditate.
dialogues.text:
With a sudden flash of inspiration, she begged me to go to
the shrine to meditate.

dialogues.jp:
環に聞いたところこの神社は｛ゼンシュウ／禅宗｝ではないので、
座禅はできないらしい。
dialogues.en:
When Tamaki heard of this, she said that the shrine had no
Zen practitioners, so meditating wasn't possible.
dialogues.text:
When Tamaki heard of this, she said that the shrine had no
Zen practitioners, so meditating wasn't possible.

dialogues.jp: がっくりと落ち込んだ様子のななこだった。
dialogues.en: Nanako was completely crestfallen.
dialogues.text: Nanako was completely crestfallen.
